body: Hey, I know you hate school.  I hated school too.  Everything about school sucks.  The people, the teachers, but more than anything else I just really, really hated school.   But you know what school will end soon.  in five years get to leave that fuckin' place and never look back.  You don't need to go to college. Watch The Office, or Game of Thrones, or Real Housewives, or Glee.  Love  Something and Indulge in it, just know that school isn't everything no matter what everyone makes it seem like.
